title: How the W1 Google Forms workflow moves through Clay
subtitle: Each row is a table. Follow the numbers left to right. Every school check happens in Schools; people are found last, only at schools that pass. Paid steps only run on rows that passed every step before them.

steps.title: Never contact
steps.text: Formplus customers and competitors, matched on domain

steps.title: Import 50 schools
steps.text: Saved Find Companies search: 25 at 51-200, 25 at 201-500

steps.title: Free gates
steps.text: Clean domain and name, not on the Exclusions list

steps.title: Is it a school?
steps.text: Use AI on the description: A-US, B, D, not_fit or other

steps.title: Find admissions page
steps.text: Scrape the homepage, pick the admissions link. Claygent if none

steps.title: Scan the page
steps.text: Scrape it: Google Form? Jotform or Typeform? Ask keywords?

steps.title: Page asks (AI)
steps.text: Documents? Fee? Paper form? yes, no or unclear, with quotes

steps.title: Route to a cell
steps.text: Asks x paper = cells 1 to 6. Unclear goes to Review

steps.title: Find one contact
steps.text: People search from the Passed view. Title rank keeps 1 per school

steps.title: Email and copy
steps.text: Find and verify the email, write the lines, push to a paused campaign
